rules: A01-A08 and E01 are promotional illustrations, not real gameplay capture.
G01-G07 must be captured from the live game runtime only.
Do not fake gameplay, fake HUD, store UI, or runtime effects.
Do not alter project assets, runtime code, Firebase, or Graphics Studio values for this video dossier.

source_stills.visible_description_ko: 교실에서 분홍 단발 주인공이 달리며 뒤돌아보고, 뒤에는 초록 블록형 좀비 학생들이 몰려온다.
큰 연필이 전경을 가로지르고, 주인공이 교실 중앙에서 던지는 자세를 취한다.
주인공이 30cm 자를 휘두르며 노란 궤적을 만들고, 주변에 좀비 학생들이 있다.
작은 분홍 트윈테일 동료가 떠 있고 별·토끼 모양 분홍 효과가 퍼진다.
어두운 긴 머리 동료가 하트 오라 속에서 앉은 주인공에게 손을 내민다.
메달을 단 작은 강아지와 주인공이 복도를 달리고, 뒤에는 좀비와 종이가 보인다.
안경을 쓴 거대한 초록 블록형 좀비 보스와 작은 주인공이 대치한다.
주인공과 세 친구가 석양의 학교문과 포탈 빛을 향해 웃으며 달린다.
인물과 글자 없는 석양 학교 입구 배경이며 오른쪽에 금빛 포탈 같은 테두리 빛이 있다.

shots.editor_action_ko: 전진 줌과 추격감, 종이·빛줄기 미세 움직임. 자막: 학교가 좀비로 가득?!
shots.prompt_en: Animate this vertical anime game promotional still while preserving the exact character design and composition. The pink-haired schoolgirl runs through a sunlit classroom and looks back over her shoulder as blocky green zombie students crowd behind her. Use a slow forward push-in with a slight handheld chase feeling. Add subtle movement only to loose papers, sunbeams, hair tips, skirt hem, and background zombie bobbing. Keep the girl’s red jacket, white shirt, yellow tie, blue skirt, blue backpack, red eyes, and short pink bob unchanged. Bright colorful Korean cartoon game style, exciting but not horror.
shots.negative_prompt_en:
No gore, no scary realism, no new UI, no text, no logo, no extra protagonist, no change to the girl’s face, no change to the zombies into realistic monsters, no collapsing desks into chaos beyond the still, no extreme camera spin.

shots.editor_action_ko: 연필 방향 푸시 인, 속도선. 연필 형태 고정. 자막: 연필로 반격!
shots.prompt_en: Animate this still as a dynamic pencil-throw moment. Preserve the exact source composition: a huge yellow pencil crosses the foreground toward the viewer, the pink-haired schoolgirl stands in the classroom, and blocky green zombie students are behind her. Add a fast but clean camera push following the pencil tip, with bright speed lines and a small impact anticipation shimmer. Keep the pencil clearly shaped like a school pencil, not a weapon blade. Maintain the protagonist’s outfit, face, hair, backpack, and anime game art style.
shots.negative_prompt_en:
No pencil morphing into a spear, bullet, sword, or missile; no fake gameplay HUD; no text; no new characters; no warped pencil tip; no changed costume; no gore; no realistic horror lighting.

shots.capture_instruction_ko: 실제 게임에서 연필 발사→명중→히트 피드백을 2초 안에 캡처.

shots.editor_action_ko: 좌→우 패닝, 노란 궤적. 30cm 자가 칼처럼 보이지 않게 유지.
shots.prompt_en: Animate this still as a ruler swing action beat. Preserve the visible classroom-like environment with windows, desks, the pink-haired schoolgirl, the transparent yellow 30cm ruler, and blocky green zombie students. Add a short left-to-right camera pan following the ruler arc, with sparkling yellow impact stars and a clean cartoon motion trail. The ruler must remain a transparent measuring ruler with visible markings. Keep the action playful and school-themed, not violent.
shots.negative_prompt_en:
No ruler turning into a knife, sword, metal blade, or weapon; no blood; no gore; no fake UI; no text; no costume change; no deformed hands; no extra ruler; no excessive blur hiding the ruler shape.

shots.editor_action_ko: 분홍 별·토끼 파티클 반짝임. 자막: 지원 등장!
shots.prompt_en: Animate this still as a cheerful support magic moment. Add gentle upward floating motion for the companion, twinkling pink particles, and a soft burst of bunny/star light. Keep both characters’ faces, hairstyles, proportions, and costumes stable. Bright playful cooperative anime game mood.
shots.negative_prompt_en:
